sql: WITH joined_data AS (SELECT wm_finance_monthly.revenue, wm_finance_monthly.operating_profit, wm_customers.region FROM wm_finance_monthly LEFT JOIN wm_contracts ON wm_finance_monthly.contract_id = wm_contracts.id LEFT JOIN wm_customers ON wm_contracts.customer_id = wm_customers.id WHERE wm_finance_monthly.month >= '2026-01-01' AND wm_finance_monthly.month < '2026-12-31' AND wm_customers.region = 'West') SELECT SUM(joined_data.revenue) AS waste_revenue, 100.0 * SUM(joined_data.operating_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(joined_data.revenue), 0) AS waste_operating_margin_pct, joined_data.region AS region FROM joined_data GROUP BY joined_data.region LIMIT 5000
